notes: Competitors are capped at max(20 x the best apxchol total on the same matrix and device, 30 s). A timeout or an over-cap run is exceeded_cap; its measured times are kept with cap_s.
CPU series use 64 threads on one socket of an exclusive node; CMG is serial.

ParAC uses patch 0007 (original-system stopping) and 0008 (benchmark I/O). 'own RHS' is ParAC's zero-sum right-hand side as on Daint; 'shared RHS' is the campaign's common b. Shared-RHS CPU graph mode solves disconnected graphs per connected component.
GPU apxchol series: default degree quantile 0.5, plus q0.8 and q0.2 as on Daint.
max_rss_mb is the process peak. GPU memory is not published: these binaries recorded device-wide usage, not per-process usage.
Thread scaling (1 to 128 threads, both sockets at 128) is under 'scaling', capped per thread count.
